R4790.summary: Signed 'Vescovi(?) de Fermo', to Sforza Attendolo, 'magnifico capitanio', Naples, 10 March 1413: Carlo di Ludovico da Cesena reports that King Ladislaus is willing to make a marriage alliance with Sforza and offers two girls of his house, the daughter of Ludovico di messer Gianni de' Malatesti or the daughter of Niccolò Filippo Brancaleoni of Castel Durante. Sforza married Caterina Alopo in 1415, so the offer came to nothing. Decryption and translation are George Lasry's, verbatim from his report; his CTTS transcription is not in the repository.
R4790.en:
Letter
Magnificent captain, know(?) that Carlo di Ludovico da Cesena has come to Naples, and he has told me that the
lord King is content to make a marriage alliance with you. But of the two girls(?) of [?] [?] [?] nothing(?) seems
possible, because the one who was promised ? to the brother of messer Ludovico da Fermo cannot be undone;
as for the marriage, her sister ? is perhaps ten years old, so she would not be suitable(?).
Now it is new(?), but the lord King says that he has [?] two beautiful girls of his house: one is the daughter of
Ludovico di messer Gianne de' Malatesti; she is very beautiful and legitimate, eighteen years old. The other is a
niece of the lord King on the side of [?]; she is the daughter of Niccolò Filippo(?) di Brancaleoni of Castel
Durante: [she is] very beautiful and legitimate.

snip.cap: No. 12, the first lines: signs divided by short strokes; the crown-like sign in line 2 is Re, the King
snip.credit: Archivio di Stato di Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 12, via DECODE R4790 (image P2)

system: Homophonic substitution on graphic signs with word dividers: two to three signs for each vowel and several consonants, a crown sign for 'Re' and a few name signs (report: 46 distinct signs).
